label_basis: 205 AI-assisted provisional spans; only 15 additionally assistant-reviewed; no independent human agreement

recipe.selection_disclosure: Primary is retrospective; secondary was the historical test-F1 maximum. Neither is an unbiased confirmatory model selection estimate.
recipe.threshold_policy: dev maximum F1; ties by precision, recall, accuracy, then lower threshold; test fixed; no additional rounding
recipe.prior_policy: Unsmoothed dev error prevalence by pre-annotated fact type; unseen types use overall dev prevalence. This is an annotation-composition diagnostic, not an information-matched detector: types are manually supplied and names such as malformed_number and unsupported_business_claim already convey correctness hints.

bootstrap.policy: Paired test-cluster percentile differences; both methods recomputed on each identical draw; dev fits held fixed. Conditional on provisional labels, not selection-adjusted. Period components join overlapping months transitively.

signal_interpretation.max_selected_step_energy_gap: Mathematically max token NLL; floating-point alias audit, not independent evidence for an energy family.
signal_interpretation.mean_spilled_probability_mass_after_top2: Probability concentration control, not proof of a distinct energy mechanism.
signal_interpretation.negative_mean_spilled_energy_delta: Opposite orientation control of the same signed statistic.
signal_interpretation.adjacent_step_energy: Retained as historical diagnostics; paper-formula fidelity and time-index audit remain Stage F.

recipe.missing_question_policy: q_0048 is dev and has no spans. Do not infer labels or correctness. B2 must separately add reviewed labels and study threshold sensitivity.
recipe.probability_provenance: Raw teacher-forced forward logits after generation, not the temperature/top-p/top-k sampling distribution. Saved float32 values are aggregated without additional decimal rounding; original logit precision is not recovered.

caveats: Both retrospective analysis arms preserve old labels, spans, question selection and business definitions.
No new winner is selected. max_selected_step_energy_gap is retained only as an NLL alias diagnostic, not independent energy-family evidence.
AP is non-interpolated average precision, not trapezoidal PR area. All-constant-score AP equals the observed positive prevalence.
Intervals are exploratory and conditional on fixed dev policies; they do not correct test-selection bias, annotation error, or unknown dependencies.

Exact-evidence grouping and overlapping-month components are sensitivity analyses. Components are constructed from all 35 evaluated dev/test questions (including dev bridges), then resampled on test only. Only two period components remain: their intervals are not reliable inferential confidence bounds.

Fact-type prior uses pre-annotated types, including outcome-hinting names such as malformed_number. It is an annotation-composition control, not an information-matched detector or automatic extraction system.
No-positive AP, one-class AUROC and one-class balanced accuracy are undefined (null). Zero-denominator MCC and zero-predicted-positive precision are set to zero.
B2 q_0048 review and threshold sensitivity remain pending. No new model generations or confirmation data are read.
Legacy Unicode fallback normalization is preserved and checked against complete saved answers, not a general tokenizer alignment solution.
